original_test_intent: Verify ADDDC allocates a second bank-VLS region when a failed rank already has one bank region and reaches threshold on another device in another bank, while preserving the original region.
original_method: Capture source RAS settings and exact initial VLS region; halt; prove dev0=1/bank1 differs from predecessor device/bank; set mask0x3 and inject exactly two CEs at source coordinates; verify threshold; go once; optionally observe copy_in_progress=1; compare ADDDC status to prove original region unchanged, correctly mapped second bank region present and per-rank counter cleared; restore and verify health.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE attests the initial region and different-device/different-bank target, controls exactly two CEs/go and recovery while the agent compares resulting ADDDC regions.
required_inputs: GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM topology and POR/non-POR disposition
Initial bank-VLS device/bank/rank plus proof dev0=1 bank1 differs on both axes
Expected second-region failed/buddy mapping and counter-clear oracle
SMM completion timeout, serial/OOB recovery and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Reject changed predecessor state or unproven target geometry
Exactly two CEs; no retry to catch transient copy state
Stop on missing/wrong second region, mutation of first region, counter mismatch or hang
Preserve topology evidence and restore/recover under owner control
agent_execution_scope: Validate predecessor and two-axis target difference
Capture two CEs, threshold and post-SMM region/counter state
Observe copy state as supporting evidence
Do not choose target, inject/retry/recover independently or issue verdict

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SMI, threshold2, ADDDC, POR caveat, dev1/bank1 coordinates, two CEs, two-region/counter expectations and30/30 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: From an attested one-bank VLS state, threshold another device in another bank and verify ADDDC retains the first region while adding the mapped second region.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable topology comparison, explicit SMM timeout and audited restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Corrected errors do not show whether ADDDC chose a second bank region, rank promotion or no change.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect device/bank identity selects a different ADDDC branch; a second region changes available sparing resources.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row175 Wistron-System RAS-00132-V002: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM POR/non-POR population, CScripts version/hash/license and SMI/threshold2/ADDDC mappings; provide the predecessor bank-VLS device/bank/rank, prove dev0=1 bank1 is a different device and different unprotected bank, define threshold, preserved-first/expected-second-region and counter-clear oracle, SMM timeout and OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the two-axis fault relationship and expected two-region topology explicit, preventing rank promotion or arbitrary region changes from being mislabeled as success.
independent_technical_reasoning: Because the new strikes are on another device and another bank, the original fault locality does not expand along one device across banks; instead ADDDC can preserve the first bank region and allocate a second bank region. The before/after region table is therefore the key policy evidence. Counter clearing proves SMM consumed the new threshold, while a copy bit only confirms transient activity and may be missed. Additional CEs could consume further sparing resources and invalidate the state.
